title.zh: UK Names Six Banks to Lead First Digital Gilt Pilot
title.en: UK Names Six Banks to Lead First Digital Gilt Pilot

current_state.zh: The UK has appointed six banks to lead its first digital gilt pilot, underwriting and distributing the short-dated DIGIT bond on HSBC's Orion platform outside the country's standard debt issuance programme.
current_state.en: The UK has appointed six banks to lead its first digital gilt pilot, underwriting and distributing the short-dated DIGIT bond on HSBC's Orion platform outside the country's standard debt issuance programme.
